blurb: The Rise Golf Course is an 18-hole championship mountain course co-designed by Fred Couples and Gene Bates, located 1,000 feet above Okanagan Lake. The course features dramatic elevation changes, generous fairways, and panoramic views, designed to challenge skilled players while enjoyable for recreational golfers. Amenities include a full-service practice facility, GPS-equipped golf carts, and unique access options like helicopter or floatplane arrivals.
